# Insufficient Handling of Non-conformant Artifacts

The analyzer may encounter artifacts that do not conform to expected naming or structural guidelines (such as missing tsconfig.json files). This could lead to incomplete or inaccurate analysis results, as the framework relies on valid configurations to interpret module paths correctly.

- `knowledge_compiler/extractors/typescript_analyzer.py` — `knowledge_compiler.extractors.typescript_analyzer._find_tsconfig_aliases`
